subject: Sync: Renewal window, top-up schedule & milestone tether
messages:
From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@aureonhealth.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Sep 2025 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal options & milestone-tether idea

Hi Priyom / Camila,

Quick thank-you for last week's usage deep-dive. We ran the numbers with Finance and have two constraints going into renewal: 1) budget needs to be spread over FY26, and 2) we need measurable onboarding/integration milestones before we commit full capacity.

High-level ask: can Redwood structure a multi-year agreement that includes an early top-up (partial upfront credit) tied to milestone completion (SAML integration, model training validation, and GA launch), with the remaining capacity staged across the first 12 months? We prefer no hard auto-renew language in the legal if possible — Finance is cautious about open-ended spend.

We attached a draft that outlines expected monthly consumption and sample milestone dates (Aureon_Renewal_Draft_v1.pdf). Would love a quick sketch from your side on how this could map to co-terming our other subscription (Redwood Dedicated pool) and whether you can support burst/trial capacity during integration.

Best,
Raj Patel
Head of Platform Engineering
Aureon Health

Attachments: Aureon_Renewal_Draft_v1.pdf (summary, usage table)

From: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Raj Patel <raj.patel@aureonhealth.com>
Cc: camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Sep 2025 13:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal options & milestone-tether idea

Raj — thanks for the clear context and the draft. We can do a structure that meets both constraints; sketch below is high-level and meant to surface tradeoffs before legal/finance drafting.

Proposal (sketch):
- Term: 24 months (to give you pricing headroom and predictable unit rate).
- Upfront/top-up credit: 40% of year-1 committed tokens credited at signing (applied to hosted + dedicated consumption).
- Milestone tether: remaining year-1 allocation split into 30% released at Milestone 1 (SAML + baseline tests), 30% released at Milestone 2 (model validation + perf SLOs). Unused credits roll to year-2 bucket and amortize across Q1.
- Burst/trial: include a 60-day trial burst pool (separate meter) for onboarding spike, capped at X tokens — non-billable if under the threshold, billable scaled beyond.
- Auto-renew: default is opt-out; we can add an explicit renewal window and notice period (60 days) rather than automatic renewal to match Finance ask.

Operational items we need from Aureon to ship this as an amendment: clear milestone acceptance criteria, billing contact for invoicing cadence, and a PO or purchase order template. If that works, we will produce an amendment + SOW template (SOW-milestones.xlsx) and a redline for the contract.

I"m looping Marissa from RevOps (cc) to sanity-check invoicing cadence and Jordan from Finance for the pricing floor on multi-year.

Next step: 30-min sync tomorrow or Wednesday? I"m available 10-11am PT both days.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW-milestones.xlsx (milestone/payment mapping)

From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@aureonhealth.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal options & milestone-tether idea

Thanks Priyom — appreciate the crisp sketch. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Auto-renew: we definitely want the opt-out approach you suggested; please remove any "automatic renewal" boilerplate in the amendment and replace with a 60-day notice clause.
- Burst/trial: we like the 60-day burst idea. Can you confirm the token cap and how overages are billed if we exceed the burst pool during integration?
- Pricing: Finance wants to see a modest discount if we commit to a 24-month term given the scale and the fact we"re co-terming two products. Can you propose a two-tier price schedule (year-1 / year-2 effective rates)?

Minor ask — can we avoid multi-year minimums on the dedicated pool for the first 6 months in case our usage pattern is lower than forecast? That would make the deal easier to approve.

On schedule: a call tomorrow 10:30am PT would work for our team. Samantha (cc) will be joining.

Onward,
Raj

Subject: Fwd: Renewal options & milestone-tether idea — pricing/ops ask

Marissa / Jordan — forwarding the thread from Aureon (Raj + Samantha). They"re open to a 24-month structure but want: a milestone-tethered top-up, an explicit 60-day no-auto-renew notice, a 60-day burst pool for onboarding, and a two-tier pricing schedule. They also asked to avoid minimums on the dedicated pool for the first 6 months.

My recommendations before we put legal on it: 
- Offer: 24m with 40% upfront credit applied across hosted + dedicated; milestone releases at 30%/30%.
- Price: propose ~8% effective discount year-1, 5% year-2 (ballpark) — Jordan, can you confirm whether RevOps can support that floor and any accounting complications?
- Ops: Camila, if we include a separate burst meter, can your team ensure it won"t count against committed utilization for SLO purposes during the 60-day window?

If we can align these, I"ll draft an amendment (no auto-renew language) and attach the SOW. I"ll also prepare a short mutual action plan so they can show Procurement.

Thanks — Priyom
